feeds.title: Rosanna Davison Nutrition
feeds.description: Read about healthy recipes, clean eating, nutrition and fitness tips, and beauty and fashion inspiration. Every single recipe, article and health tip is designed to enable you to reach your highest health and beauty potential.

feeds.title: Bibliocook
feeds.description: Bibliocook is an Award-winning blog of Irish food writer and broadcaster Caroline Hennessy where she shares her experience and journey with food.

feeds.title: Anna Collins Nutrition
feeds.description: My 'Anna's Best Recipes' blog is for people who love their grub and want to experience 100% health too. It happens to be gluten-free too. Nothing cheffy, just honest-to-goodness food in a range of styles - Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Irish.

feeds.title: Gimme the recipe
feeds.description: Covers simple recipes & sometimes travel, by Irish Food Blogger Sheila Kiely. Sheila Kiely works with her husband Denis in Food Safety Consultancy business (Industrial Management Systems) and has six grown up children.

feeds.title: Donal Skehan Blog
feeds.description: Donal Skehan is a food writer, photographer and television presenter living in Dublin, Ireland. Check out his collection of over 250 simple home-cooked recipes, family life, travel and more!

feeds.title: Susan Jane White
feeds.description: Explore healthy, nutritious and tasty recipes here. I'm Susan Jane, wholefood chef, mother of two tornadoes, and author of three potty-mouthed cookbooks.

feeds.title: Cooking Classes Online Blog
feeds.description: Join our Chef Instructors and learn all their secret tips and techniques. With over 20 years in the food and cooking school business, Vanessa Greenwood, the Founder of Cooks Academy (2005-2020), has brought her cookery skills online in 2021. These online programs are a hit for corporate and social groups as well as schools and Transition Year Students.

feeds.title: Irish American Mom Blog
feeds.description: A warmhearted personal blog by Mairéad, an Irish-born mom living in America, sharing nostalgic childhood memories, Irish heritage, simple family recipes (from Guinness stew to potato cakes), seasonal crafts, and the everyday joys of raising her children while staying connected to her roots.

feeds.title: Jono & Jules do food & wine
feeds.description: These are all recipes that we have tried at home and that have worked well. We are both mad into wine and stick all our good value recommendations on here as we know how difficult it can be to find something interesting without breaking the bank. Jono has his WSET Diploma in wines and spirits and has been working in the wine industry since 2002. Julie is catching up fast and is the process of studying for the WSET Diploma.

feeds.title: The View from Great Island » Irish
feeds.description: Find Authentic Irish recipes for St Patrick's Day or any day, like colcannon, soda bread, Irish stew and traditional Irish apple cake. Sue is a food blogger, food photographer and recipe developer.

feeds.title: Natural Born Feeder Blog
feeds.description: Roz Purcell is a bestselling cookery author and entrepreneur. Roz has successfully launched a stellar media career which includes a winning role on Come Dine with Me Ireland, a guest chef appearance on TV3s the Restaurant, and a stint as a Celebrity Bainisteor on RTE. Her passion for healthy food and lifestyle has earned her thousands of followers on social media in recent years.

feeds.title: Easy Food
feeds.description: The home of quality home cooking! Find all your favourite recipes, tried and tested for you in our test kitchen, plus step-by-step videos, healthy eating tips and top cooking techniques to help you cook like a pro.

feeds.title: The Little Green Spoon
feeds.description: Blog posts on nutrient-rich, gluten free and refined sugar free, with many paleo, dairy free and vegan options. Indy Power's cooking is not about giving up things, least of all taste. It is about embracing natural, nutritious and nourishing foods. She is constantly experimenting to develop new recipes and put a healthy twist on some old favorites.

feeds.title: French Foodie in Dublin
feeds.description: I am Ketty Quigley, I started this blog in 2012 as a journal of my food experiences and to spread my love about Dublins food scene. I always pay for my meals and only write about places I am happy to recommend, be it a fancy restaurant or a hidden gem of a cafe. I hope you enjoy reading my blog!

feeds.title: GastroGays
feeds.description: We are GastroGays. Since 2013, we've been blogging about what we eat and where we visit around the world. We're internationally published freelance writers in magazines and newspapers, including The Irish Times, The Guardian, Independent Travel (UK), Gay Times Magazine. We're also cooks on TV3's' Six O'Clock Show' in Ireland.

feeds.title: Kenmare Foodie
feeds.description: Karen Coakley is a Home Cook and Food Blogger living in Kenmare, Co.Kerry with her husband Vincent and their 4 sons. Her ethos with Kenmare Foodie is to lead a healthy, balanced active life and to get families back to the simple pleasures of Home Cooking and connecting through sharing family meals together.

feeds.title: The Fussy Eater
feeds.description: Covers Dublin restaurant reviews. The Fussy Eater blog will take you on a journey of Dublin restaurants as seen through the eyes of a fussy eater.

feeds.title: Meade's Menu Blog
feeds.description: I am simply sharing my insights and experiences around food for your pleasure. Its primarily a blog covering just about any aspect of food and cooking. You might sample titbits like my feedback from a meal I ate, a try out of a new place or product, a seasonal recipe, maybe about someone special I met or something in the food news that caught my eye.

feeds.title: Galmere Foods Blog
feeds.description: Explore our recipes, Irish food history and more! Galmere was born from a popular Galway restaurant. When the then owners started making coleslaw out of the restaurant kitchen, a chance meeting with a leading retailer led to the first retail listing. It was a success. Over 30 years later, Galmere is a multi-award-winning food producer, operating out of our home hub in Ballybrit, Galway.

feeds.title: Irish Wishing Well Blog » Food
feeds.description: Explore more about Irish food, authentic dishes and recipes and more! Irish Wishing Well is a personal essay blog of journalist and writer Rosemary A. Sullivan. She aims to learn all she can about the Emerald Isle and share her experiences along the way with her readers.

feeds.title: The Irish Food Guide Blog
feeds.description: The Irish Food Guide Blog includes news, foodie chat, recipes, award results, links and other general information on the Food & Tourism Industry in Ireland. It is written & curated by Zack Gallagher, Donegal Town, Co Donegal, Ireland.

feeds.title: Whole Lotta Yum » Irish
feeds.description: The Irish section features my recipes inspired by Irish cuisine along with some authentic Irish recipes. I'm Jen, a full-time recipe creator and food photographer behind Whole Lotta Yum. Our site focuses on mostly healthy recipes that are organized by diet type/food restrictions. We also have lots of easy 30 minute dinners, air fryer recipes, and Instant Pot too.

feeds.title: The Irish Kitchen
feeds.description: Snippets of life from inside an Irish kitchen featuring recipes, tips & traditions. I'm Jenn. This blog captures many of the recipes we make and activities we do around the table in our Irish Kitchen.

feeds.title: The Skinny Fork Blog » Irish
feeds.description: Explore Irish recipes, cooking tips, traditional food and more! I'm Amanda Plott, graphic designer, author, photographer, self-proclaimed foodie, and creator of TheSkinnyFork.com! I started TheSkinnyFork.com in February of 2013 with a desire to serve up my love for healthy food with a side of pretty photos and just a sprinkling of that infamous Austin quirkiness!

feeds.title: Proper Food
feeds.description: Hi, i am Katia, A mad yoke of a French woman in love with all things #IrishFood. Stick around for some interesting chats and laughs. I blog about independent small food producers and the women of the Irish food industry.

feeds.title: The Wonky Spatula
feeds.description: Welcome to The Wonky Spatula, The tasty way to be healthy. Bringing you delicious recipes that are paleo, gluten free, dairy free, vegan and more!

feeds.title: Delalicious
feeds.description: Explore delicious and fun recipes, cooking tips and more! Delalicious is a food blog created by Sinéad Delahunty which provides wholesome, real food and fun.
